settings.heading: Ilayya On Repeat
settings.text: The brunch you didn't plan for. The birthday you did. Ilayya gold goes with both, and everything in between. Gold-plated stainless steel, finished by hand, made to keep shining all day.

settings.heading: Ilayya Means To Me
settings.text: In Arabic, ilayya means ‘to me.’ We’ve always read it the other way too, as a dedication, to you. That’s the idea behind everything we make. We believe luxury should feel empowering, not exclusive: the kind of quality you reach for on an ordinary Tuesday, not just the days that call for it. We draw from silhouettes that have never gone out of style and rework them through a modern eye, chic, considered, and built to outlast a trend rather than chase one. Every piece is made to be worn daily, not saved for occasions, because that is what quality and timeless beauty mean to us. Ilayya isn’t jewelry you save for later. It’s made for right now. It’s made for you.
